parts.answer: The Jets have a greater spread of heights.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Jets have a greater variety/wider range/greater, larger, bigger, wider or ‘more’ spread of heights; equivalently Aces have a smaller spread (B1). A contextual comment must include height. Jets IQR $=18$ cm and range $=24$ cm; Aces IQR is their (b) and range $=18$ cm. Comparing values alone does not score without a contextual comment. If stated, range/IQR values must be correct or FT from (b). If multiple spread comments are given, mark the final one. Additional central-tendency comments score B0.
